svg.title: Left-left repair with the program names
svg.desc:
Left panel: black violet (k3, v3) has red blue (k2, v2) on its left and subtree d on its right. Blue has red yellow (k1, v1) on its left and c on its right; yellow has a and b. The arrow points to the right panel: red blue (k2, v2) above black yellow (k1, v1) and black violet (k3, v3). Yellow retains a and b, and violet retains c and d. The upper semicircles record Red or Black; lower colors track the associations. The green, orange, pink, and cyan triangles retain subtrees a, b, c, and d. Code labels sit beside their shapes. Each association and subtree remains unchanged.
